name: In-level Adaptive Encoding
definition: A technique to determine the optimal Number of Control Points (NCP) for a single micro-block by searching through valid NCP values to find the lowest NCP that satisfies a required error bound.
summary: In-level Adaptive Encoding determines the optimal Number of Control Points for a single micro-block by independently searching for the smallest value satisfying an error bound, unlike cross-level methods that leverage other levels of detail.
